allowed_scopes.description: Required. The list of scopes that the OauthClient is allowed to request during OAuth flows.
allowed_scopes.rationale: Restricting scopes enforces least privilege OAuth access and prevents over-permissioned identity delegation.

allowed_grant_types.description: Required. The list of OAuth grant types is allowed for the OauthClient.
allowed_grant_types.rationale: Ensures only approved OAuth flows are used to prevent insecure authentication mechanisms.

allowed_redirect_uris.description: Required. The list of redirect URIs allowed after OAuth authentication.
allowed_redirect_uris.rationale: Prevents open redirect attacks and ensures tokens are only sent to trusted endpoints.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource name.
location.rationale: OAuth clients must be deployed in global scope to ensure consistent IAM enforcement.

oauth_client_id.description: Required. The ID used for the OauthClient resource.
oauth_client_id.rationale: Ensures predictable naming and avoids reserved prefix misuse.

disabled.rationale: Disabled clients cannot be used, reducing attack surface when not in use.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the OAuth client.
display_name.non-compliant: Very Long Invalid Name That Exceeds Limits

description.rationale: Provides documentation for audit and governance.

client_type.rationale: Restricts OAuth clients to approved secure types only.

project.description: Project where the resource is created.
